title: Explicit stabilized implementation of singly diagonally implicit Runge-Kutta methods
summary: Implicit methods are a natural approach for the integration of stiff differential equations, to avoid time-step restrictions faced by standard explicit integrators. Explicit stabilised integrators are an alternative to implicit methods, which can be particularly efficient in high-dimensional applications with diffusive terms. Towards the best of both worlds, we introduce a new explicit stabilised implementation of a class of diagonally implicit Runge-Kutta methods.
